steps.en: Install the library and register your image storage with OCR disabled
steps.zh: 安装库，注册自有图片存储并关闭 OCR

steps.en: Pass PDF bytes to its converter and request a document tree
steps.zh: 把 PDF 字节交给转换器，请求文档树

steps.en: Parse pages and relationships, then handle images through your provider
steps.zh: 解析页面与关系，经你的适配器处理图片

component.zh: PDF 转换器与图片适配器

steps.en: Build hierarchy and Markdown, return the document-tree model
steps.zh: 重建层级与 Markdown，返回文档树模型

value.en: Structured blocks and inferred hierarchy for downstream ingestion, not a complete RAG system
value.zh: 取得结构块与推断层级供后续摄取，不是完整检索系统
